pack_count=0
pack_bytes=0
while IFS=$'\t' read -r rel bytes sha; do
  dst="$base/orchestration/$rel"
  test -f "$dst"
  actual_bytes=$(wc -c < "$dst")
  actual_sha=$(sha256sum "$dst" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  test "$actual_bytes" = "$bytes"
  test "$actual_sha" = "$sha"
  pack_count=$((pack_count + 1))
  pack_bytes=$((pack_bytes + actual_bytes))
done < <(jq -r '.files[] | [.relative_destination,(.bytes|tostring),.sha256] | @tsv' "$manifest")
test "$pack_count" = "$(jq '.files | length' "$manifest")"
test "$pack_bytes" = "$(jq '[.files[].bytes] | add' "$manifest")"
